name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Page numbers as cells with a cobalt current page; constant width while paging; folds to "5 / 20" when narrow; buttons or links.
whenToUse: Use it to move between pages of a long list or table. For tables with paging worked out for you use Data table.

parts.name: Pagination
parts.description: Page numbers as cells in one frame: - The window keeps a constant number of cells (first, last, the current page and its siblings, and gaps), and number cells are as wide as the largest page number: the frame never changes width while you page, so Previous and Next stay under the pointer. - The current page is cobalt (location) with aria-current="page"; it stays focusable, it does nothing. - Below 360px of its own width the numbers fold into one "5 / 20" cell between Previous and Next. - Previous and Next mirror in RTL; they are out of service (hatched) at the ends. - Buttons by default; `getHref` makes them links (Previous/Next at the ends become plain cells).

props.name: getHref
props.description: Links instead of buttons: the page's URL. Each number is then an <a>, so pages open in new tabs.

props.name: layout
props.description: control: its own 2px frame. cell: a row of an enclosing frame (a panel's or table's footer).

props.name: pageCount
props.description: How many pages. null while unknown: the numbers show "–" and every cell is out of service.

props.name: pageLabel
props.description: Text read for a page number (default "Page 4").

props.name: siblings
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current one (default 1).
